notes.title: Patch #5
notes.content:
This time we have a patch with fewer new features, and more bug fixes. Well, there's the 4th Cycle, which really should set your Doom Clock spinning.

Here's the change list:

[list]
[*] [CYCLES] 4th Cycle added!
[*] [CYCLES] Game now remembers which Cycle you've played last time
[*] [CUTSCENES] Improved cutscenes
[*] [BOSS] Added spawns to the final boss fight, making it a bit more difficult
[*] [WARDENCLYFFE] Game now remembers your previous startup weapon and character choices
[*] [UI] Added information about your current cycle
[*] [UI] Level and World seed are now visible in the menu
[*] [BUG] Closing spawning portals no longer reduces overall enemy spawns
[*] [BUG] Medikit can once again be picked up while in mech
[*] [BUG] Frozen Bullets no longer freeze monsters death animations
[*] [BUG] Inhibitor freeze no longer carried over to next run
[*] [BUG] Inhibitor no longer spawns outside play area
[*] [BUG] Improved Workshop perk now works properly
[*] [BUG] Worldmap now generated correctly after you load a previous game
[*] [BUG] Quest rewards now properly added to your crystal total
[*] [BUG] Fixed Untouchable
[*] [BUG] Fixed Kinetic Inverter Perk
[*] [BUG] Should the player ever fall off the play area, they are now teleported back
[*] [BUG] Fixed rare water drawing issues
[*] [BUG] Fixed Cultist Boss movement and tentacle animations
[*] [BUG] Fixed Champion monsters in Cycle 2+
[*] [BUG] Fixed Workshop opening itself at ill times
[*] [BUG] Fixed Perk listings, occasionally some perks were drawn with incorrect numbers
[*] [BUG] Fixed ground drawing bugs
[*] [BUG] Made Wardenclyffe upgrade menus easier to open
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #4: Darwin - Full Launch!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we've left the Early Access with this update! Both Shelley and Lovecraft are now playable. We've also added three all-new cutscenes to flesh out the story. We've also expanded the inventions available at Wardenclyffe.

We'd like to thank everyone who participated in the Early Access and helped us shape the game to be much better. We couldn't have done it without your valuable input! ːsteamhappyː 

As we just previously released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1149710/view/2940249452749318262]0.9 patch[/url], the 1.0 is much smaller in scope.

Changelist:
[list]
[*] [CHARACTERS] Lovecraft is now playable! You can unlock him by completing the quest.
[*] [UPGRADES] Four (4) new upgrades added to Wardenclyffe!
[*] [CUTSCENES] Added 4 all-new cutscenes to the game! And a menu for rewatching!
[*] [PERKS] Duplicate perks are no longer possible to acquire from Wardenclyffe. It was OP!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #3: Copernicus!
notes.content:
It's time for something people have been asking since day one: We're releasing a new playable character, Shelley!

[h1]Mary Shelley[/h1]
While she might not be a scientist like Tesla and Curie, that hasn't stopped her from building a mechanical monster of her own... She has created MECHENSTEIN. By wiring dolphin brains into the Mech, she has rendered it autonomous, freeing herself from piloting the mech.

But wouldn't that leave her vulnerable, you ask? Fear not, for she has an electric power shield surrounding her! Powered by Energy Cells, it should be enough to keep her away from harm's way. And should it wear down, it will explode taking down nearby monsters with a bang, allowing Shelley to escape.

And make sure to pay a visit to the cemetery as well, for she might find something useful there... 

[h1]Wardenclyffe Update[/h1]
Other important updates include changes to the Perks and Weapons acquired at the Wardenclyffe. Previously, you had to pay for each perk and weapon you picked up. And if you died, well, too bad. We've changed that! Instead of buying individual perks, you'll be buying PERMANENT slots, which can be filled with perks freely! Weapons will have a similar system, in which you upgrade your Tech Tier, unlocking new weapons to start the game. Buying Perk Slots and Weapon Tech Tiers will cost you crystals though... but we have a solution for that too!

[h1]And more, much more.[/h1]
QUESTS! For each run, you'll be given quests you can complete. Most of then the quests will give you crystal rewards at the end of the run, but sometimes they unlock new features.

On top of that, we have plenty of fixes, improvements, and tweaks. Here's the complete change list:

[list]
[*] [CHARACTERS] Shelley now playable!
[*] [ACHIEVEMENTS] Achievements now available!
[*] [WARDENCLYFFE] Revamped Wardenclyffe layout
[*] [WARDENCLYFFE] Revamped the way weapons are picked in the Wardenclyffe!
[*] [WARDENCLYFFE] Revamped the way perks are picked in the Wardenclyffe!
[*] [QUESTS] Added Quests that players can complete for nice rewards
[*] [CYCLES] Added 3rd difficulty Cycle
[*] [PERKS] Improved Regeneration perk from heal 10 to heal 15
[*] [MONSTERS] Spiderghouls now move nefariously
[*] [MONSTERS] Fire Vampires now move in bursts
[*] [ENVIRONMENT] Levels given new look with improved lightning
[*] [ENVIRONMENT] New props added to city levels
[*] [ENVIRONMENT] Improved fog visuals
[*] [LEVEL GENERATION] Improved level generation algorithms
[*] [GFX] Improved water effects
[*] [GFX] Menu visuals improved
[*] [BUG] Fixed control binding issues
[*] [PERFORMANCE] Improved performance
[*] [CONTROLS] Added optional Vibra effects to gamepads
[*] [BUG] Fixed crashes
[*] [BUG] Fixed control binding issues
[*] [BUG] Fixed Host Boss
[*] [BUG] Fixed interactions of Frost Bullets and various weapons
[*] [BUG] Fixed controller pairing issues in coop mode
[*] [BUG] Fixed perk listings in the world map and ending screen
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2: Becquerel
notes.content:
[h2]0.8.2 Becquerel[/h2]
We have a new patch to announce, and it's a big one!

We've revamped the meta-game, by separating each chapter into own runs. Previously, all three chapters were part of one run consisting of 21 levels. Now, each chapter is a 10 level long run. Once you defeat the boss at the end of the chapter, you return to Wardenclyffe and receive your rewards. So now you don't have to return to chapter 1 if you die in chapter 2. This also allowed us to make each chapter a bit longer!

We have improved the level generation algorithms, added new assets and even new environmental mix: Farm Outskirts.

There are two new perks ([b]Feral Instict[/b] and [b]Gifted[/b]) and weapons (Grenade Launcher and Blackhole Grenade Launcher). We also worked on the game balance, and it should be better now.

We have also included analytics opt-in, that allows the game to collects & send anonymous play data that will help us to balance and improve the game. This is completely optional, and is turned off by default.

[h2]Full changelist[/h2]
[RUN] Each chapter is now a separate run!
[RUN] Chapters extended by about 50%
[WORLDMAP] Improved Worldmap
[WEAPON] Grenade Launcher added
[WEAPON] Blackhole Grenade Launcher added
[WEAPON] Teslazi changed to Burst fire
[PERK] Feral Instinct Perk added
[PERK] Gifted Perk added
[PERK] Legendary perks are now Rare perks instead
[ENVIRONMENT] New Environmental mix, Farm Outskirts, added
[LEVEL GENERATION] Improved level generation algorithms
[UI] Improved Weapon Rewards screen, now with detailed comparisons
[UI] General UI improvements
[BUG] Monsters should no longer spawn outside play area
[MISSION] ELITE monsters now spawn with delay
[MISSION] Inhibitor missions now slightly more difficult
[ENCOUNTERS] New Encounters added
[ANALYTICS] OPTIONAL gameplay data analytics added
[GFX] Added shockwave efffect to Mech explosion

notes.title: First Update coming soon
notes.content:
[h1]Updates![/h1]
Since the release of the Early Access version last Wednesday, we have been going through all the feedback we have got from all of you. We wanted to let you know that we are working on some changes and improvements! Naturally, not everything is going to happen immediately, but we'll try to make these updates as frequent as possible. The first bug fix and update is due this week. Here's a short view of what we are planning for the future:

[h2]Reviving in COOP[/h2]
When a player dies in the coop mode, other players will be able to revive them by using Energy Cells. But you better watch out, for the cost to revive increases with each use. If everyone dies, it's all over.

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
There will be more weapons, and we'll adjust existing weapons to make them more exciting and balanced. On top of that, we are planning to give you the ability to switch between TWO weapons you are carrying.

[h2]Better Upgrades[/h2]
We're planning to revise the use of crystals at the Wardenclyffe, and we've come up with a few cool ideas. You'll hear more about that later...

[h2]Improved Level Generation[/h2]
We've been improving the level generator algorithm, to provide more varied environments.  

We also have more updates in mind such as new Cycles, weapons, monsters, and perks, but we'll talk about them later. Stay tuned for further updates!

Thanks everyone for participating the Steam Game Festival as players and viewers.

We are already looking forward to the next possible incarnation of Steam Game Festivals, with Tesla Force or some other upcoming game. Now it is time for us to concentrate on polishing the game for Early Access launch in August 5th.

Oh, and one more thing. We'll be releasing a [b]double[/b] feature soundtrack, containing music from both [b]Tesla Force[/b] and [b]Tesla vs Lovecraft[/b]. We are excited that we could collaborate with the composer, known as [b]Pandocrator[/b]. Stay tuned for the official soundtrack page, it will sound epic!

notes.title: Test Drive the it Now!
notes.content:
Do you think you've got what it takes to defeat Eldritch monsters trying to destroy the city of Arkham? Tesla Force is an intense twin-stick action rogue-lite with science and monsters to spare. Fight against the endless waves of monstrosities with Tesla Mech and other innovative gadgets. Slash Deep Ones with X-Ray Blades and hunt down the spawns of Dagons with Ion Shotgun. Join Nikola Tesla, Marie Curie, Mary Shelley, and HP Lovecraft in Tesla Force!

notes.title: Crimsonland devs going zapping again with Tesla Force
notes.content:
Shmup shpecialists 10tons have announced a new top-down shoot ’em up, Tesla Force: United Scientists Army. It’s a follow-up to 2018’s Tesla Vs Lovecraft, pitting Tesla, Lovecraft, Curie, and Shelley against yet more spooky hordes in a “rogue-lite” way with procedurally-generated levels. I know, I know, it’s not 2012 anymore, but 10tons know their shmup shtuff. They’re also behind Crimsonland, Jydge, and other zappers that are quite zim-zam. Here, have a peek at Tesla Force in the announcement trailer.
